summary.text: Ogden Driskill is a Republican member of the Wyoming State Senate for District 1, in office since 2011, and has served as Senate president since January 2023; he is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a rancher and the owner of Double Spear Ranch.

paragraphs.text: Ogden Driskill earned an associate degree at Casper College in 1980 and later attended the University of Wyoming.
He challenged incumbent Mark Semlek for the Wyoming House of Representatives District 1 seat in the 2004 primary and lost.
Driskill joined the state Senate in 2011, served as majority leader from 2021 to January 10, 2023, and has been Senate president since that date.
He was a delegate to the 2016 Republican National Convention from Wyoming.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Senate Appropriations Committee, the Joint Appropriations Committee, the Select Water Committee and the Select Committee on Capital Financing and Investments.
